```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(readxl)
library(knitr)

# Force English month names in the report output; avoid locale-specific strings like "říj".
old_locale <- Sys.getlocale("LC_TIME")
Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")
on.exit(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", old_locale), add = TRUE)

out_dir <- "."
```

**Data:** `pilot_data.xlsx` from GitHub (janurban/moral_experiment), a Qualtrics export with numeric codes.
**Reference documents:** `questionnaire.docx`, `pre-registration.docx`, student pilot feedback.
**Treatment coding (column `Group`):** VU = control (sleep text), CZG T1 = harm-care, CZG T2 = purity.

Every number in this report is computed when the file is rendered. To render it, run
`rmarkdown::render("pilot_report.Rmd")` for the GitHub version, or
`rmarkdown::render("pilot_report.Rmd", "pdf_document")` for a PDF.

## 0. Data download and date filter

The data are downloaded directly from GitHub. Only responses that **started after 15 October 2026** are kept, that is, with a `StartDate` on or after 16 October 2026 at 00:00 in the Qualtrics export time zone.

```{r load, echo = TRUE}
# Download pilot data from GitHub
data_url  <- "https://github.com/janurban/moral_experiment/raw/refs/heads/main/pilot_data.xlsx"
data_file <- file.path(tempdir(), "pilot_data.xlsx")
download.file(data_url, destfile = data_file, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)

# Read: dates as dates, everything else as text.
# Row 1 of the sheet = variable names, row 2 = question text, data from row 3.
hdr    <- names(read_excel(data_file, n_max = 0))
types  <- ifelse(hdr %in% c("StartDate", "EndDate", "RecordedDate"), "date", "text")
raw    <- suppressWarnings(read_excel(data_file, col_types = types))
labels <- setNames(as.character(unlist(raw[1, ])), hdr)
full   <- as.data.frame(raw[-1, ], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Keep responses started after 15 October 2026
cutoff  <- as.POSIXct("2026-10-16 00:00:00", tz = "UTC")
keep    <- !is.na(full$StartDate) & full$StartDate >= cutoff
dat     <- full[keep, ]
dropped <- full[!keep, ]
```

```{r filter-table}
dropped_range <- if (nrow(dropped) == 0L) "none" else {
  old_locale <- Sys.getlocale("LC_TIME")
  Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C")
  on.exit(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", old_locale), add = TRUE)
  paste0(format(min(dropped$StartDate, na.rm = TRUE), "%d %b"), " to ",
         format(max(dropped$StartDate, na.rm = TRUE), "%d %b %Y"))
}

kable(data.frame(
  Step = c("Rows in `pilot_data.xlsx`",
           paste0("Removed by the date filter (StartDate ", dropped_range, ")"),
           "**Kept**"),
  n = c(nrow(full), nrow(dropped), paste0("**", nrow(dat), "**"))))
```

```{r codebook}
trim      <- function(x) gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$", "", x)
seq_map   <- function(codes, values) setNames(values, as.character(codes))
map_codes <- function(x, map) {
  x <- trim(as.character(x))
  x[!is.na(x)] <- sub("\\.0$", "", x[!is.na(x)])
  unname(map[x])
}

maps <- list(
  emo    = seq_map(1:5, 0:4),
  att    = seq_map(1:4, 1:4),
  s17    = seq_map(1:7, 1:7),
  q07b   = c("1" = 1, "2" = 2, "8" = 3, "9" = 4, "10" = 5, "11" = 6, "3" = 7),
  q07c   = c("1" = 1, "2" = 2, "8" = 3, "9" = 4, "10" = 5, "3" = 6, "4" = 7),
  mfq    = seq_map(1:6, 0:5),
  choice = c("1" = 0, "2" = 1))

products <- c(Q10 = "drink", Q11 = "yogurt", Q12 = "cheese", Q13 = "mayo",
              Q14 = "butter", Q15 = "icecream", Q16 = "sausages", Q17 = "mince",
              Q18 = "meatballs", Q19 = "ham", Q20 = "patties")
ppl <- c("me", "other people", "the environment", "animals")

cb <- rbind(
  data.frame(block = "Q04 Emotions", var = paste0("emotions_", 1:6), map = "emo", min = 0, max = 4,
             text = c("Disgusted", "Revolted", "Nauseated", "Compassionate", "Sympathetic", "Moved"),
             construct = rep(c("Disgust", "Compassion"), each = 3)),
  data.frame(block = "Q05 Attention check", var = "attention check", map = "att", min = 1, max = 4,
             text = "describes best the text", construct = "Attention check"),
  data.frame(block = "Q06 Moralization", var = paste0("moralization_", 1:4), map = "s17", min = 1, max = 7,
             text = c("core moral beliefs", "right", "moral issue", "just know"),
             construct = "Moralization"),
  data.frame(block = "Q07 Perceived harm", var = paste0("Q07a_", 1:4), map = "s17", min = 1, max = 7,
             text = paste0("physical harm ... - to ", ppl), construct = "Perceived harm"),
  data.frame(block = "Q07 Perceived harm", var = paste0("Q07b_", 1:4), map = "q07b", min = 1, max = 7,
             text = paste0("pain and suffering ... - to ", ppl), construct = "Perceived harm"),
  data.frame(block = "Q07 Perceived harm", var = paste0("Q07c_", 1:4), map = "q07c", min = 1, max = 7,
             text = paste0("mistreats ... - ", sub("^to ", "", ppl)), construct = "Perceived harm"),
  data.frame(block = "Q08 Association check", var = paste0("association check_", 1:4), map = "s17",
             min = 1, max = 7,
             text = c("pain or distress", "living conditions", "hygienic", "unpleasant smells"),
             construct = rep(c("Harm association", "Purity association"), each = 2)),
  data.frame(block = "Q10-Q20 Choice task", var = names(products), map = "choice", min = 0, max = 1,
             text = "most likely purchase", construct = paste0("Choice (", products, ")")),
  data.frame(block = "Q22 MFQ relevance", var = paste0("Q22_", 1:7), map = "mfq", min = 0, max = 5,
             text = c("suffered emotionally", "weak or vulnerable", "was cruel", "purity and decency",
                      "something disgusting", "God would approve", "good at math"),
             construct = c(rep("MFQ care", 3), rep("MFQ purity", 3), "Filler")),
  data.frame(block = "Q23 MFQ agreement", var = paste0("Q23_", 1:7), map = "mfq", min = 0, max = 5,
             text = c("Compassion for those", "defenseless animal", "kill a human being",
                      "disgusting, even if no one", "unnatural", "Chastity", "better to do good"),
             construct = c(rep("MFQ care", 3), rep("MFQ purity", 3), "Filler")))
it <- function(con) cb$var[cb$construct == con]
```

```{r sample}
dat$group <- factor(c(VU = "control", `CZG T1` = "harm", `CZG T2` = "purity")[trim(dat$Group)],
                    levels = c("control", "harm", "purity"))
assigned <- !is.na(dat$group)
finished <- !is.na(dat$Finished) & (as.character(dat$Finished) == "1" | as.numeric(dat$Finished) == 1)
completed <- assigned & finished
n_screen   <- sum(!assigned)
n_assigned <- sum(assigned)
n_dropout  <- sum(assigned & !finished)
n_comp     <- sum(completed)
grp_n      <- table(dat$group[completed])
screen_codes <- paste(sort(unique(dat$Q0b[!assigned])), collapse = ", ")
```

## 1. Summary

```{r presence}
expected <- c("Q0b", "Group", cb$var)
present  <- expected %in% names(dat)
cb$text_ok <- mapply(function(v, t) v %in% names(dat) && grepl(t, labels[[v]], fixed = TRUE),
                     cb$var, cb$text)
has_country <- any(tolower(names(dat)) %in% c("country", "q_country"))
has_do      <- any(grepl("_DO", names(dat)))
n_id        <- sum(!is.na(dat$id))
```

```{r range}
num <- data.frame(ResponseId = dat$ResponseId, group = dat$group)
res <- list(); long <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(cb))) {
  v <- cb$var[i]
  rx  <- trim(dat[[v]])
  val <- map_codes(rx, maps[[cb$map[i]]])
  num[[v]] <- val
  r <- rx[completed]; x <- val[completed]
  codes <- sort(unique(r[!is.na(r)]))
  codes <- codes[order(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(codes)))]
  obs_minmax <- if (length(x) == 0L || all(is.na(x))) "" else {
    lo <- suppressWarnings(min(x, na.rm = TRUE))
    hi <- suppressWarnings(max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
    if (is.finite(lo) && is.finite(hi)) paste0(lo, "-", hi) else ""
  }
  res[[v]] <- data.frame(
    Variable = paste0("`", v, "`"), Construct = cb$construct[i],
    `Raw codes` = paste(codes, collapse = ","),
    Expected = paste0(cb$min[i], "-", cb$max[i]),
    Valid = sum(!is.na(x)), Missing = sum(is.na(r)),
    `Invalid code` = sum(!is.na(r) & is.na(x)),
    `Out of range` = sum(!is.na(x) & (x < cb$min[i] | x > cb$max[i])),
    `Observed min-max` = obs_minmax,
    check.names = FALSE)
  tb <- table(r, useNA = "ifany")
  if (length(tb) == 0L) {
    long[[v]] <- data.frame(var = v, raw_code = NA_character_, n = 0L)
  } else {
    long[[v]] <- data.frame(var = v, raw_code = names(tb), n = as.integer(tb))
  }
}
res <- do.call(rbind, res); rownames(res) <- NULL
long <- do.call(rbind, long); rownames(long) <- NULL
n_invalid <- sum(res$`Invalid code`)
n_oor <- sum(res$`Out of range`)
n_miss <- sum(res$Missing)
if (n_invalid == 0 && n_oor == 0) {
  res <- res[, !names(res) %in% "Observed min-max"]
}
q07b_codes <- paste(sort(as.numeric(unique(unlist(dat[completed, paste0("Q07b_", 1:4)])))), collapse = ", ")
q07c_codes <- paste(sort(as.numeric(unique(unlist(dat[completed, paste0("Q07c_", 1:4)])))), collapse = ", ")
```

```{r summary-table}
kable(data.frame(
  Question = c("Are all questionnaire variables recorded?",
               "Are their ranges correct?",
               "Is something missing or unclear?"),
  Answer = c(
    if (all(present) && all(cb$text_ok))
      paste0("**Yes.** All ", nrow(cb), " item variables plus `Q0b` and `Group` are present, and every column's question text matches the expected item.")
    else "**No.** See Section 3.",
    paste0(if (n_invalid == 0 && n_oor == 0) "**Yes, after recoding.** " else "**No.** ",
           n_invalid, " invalid codes and ", n_oor,
           " out-of-range values. However, the raw Qualtrics codes are not on the questionnaire scales: Q07b uses codes ",
           q07b_codes, " and Q07c uses ", q07c_codes, ". See problem 1."),
    "**Yes.** See Sections 5 and 6.")))
```

## 3. Presence check

### 3.1 Questionnaire variables

```{r presence-table}
blk <- unique(cb$block)
kable(data.frame(
  Block = c("Q01 Diet screening", "Q03 Manipulation", blk),
  Items = c(1, 1, sapply(blk, function(b) sum(cb$block == b))),
  Present = c("Q0b" %in% names(dat), "Group" %in% names(dat),
              sapply(blk, function(b) all(cb$var[cb$block == b] %in% names(dat)))),
  `Question text matches` = c("-", "-", sapply(blk, function(b) all(cb$text_ok[cb$block == b]))),
  check.names = FALSE), row.names = FALSE)
```

### 3.2 Variables required by the preregistration

```{r prereg-table}
kable(data.frame(
  `Needed for` = c("All models (fixed effect)", "Participant identifier",
                   "Randomization checks", "Exclusion of non-completers"),
  Variable = c("Country", "`id`", "Display-order (`_DO`) columns", "Completion flag"),
  Status = c(if (has_country) "Present" else
               paste0("**Missing.** `UserLanguage` = ", paste(unique(dat$UserLanguage), collapse = ", "), "."),
             if (n_id == 0) "**Empty** for every respondent." else paste(n_id, "non-empty"),
             if (has_do) "Present" else "**Not exported.**",
             paste0("`Finished` = 0 for ", n_dropout, " drop-out(s), but screened-out respondents also have Finished = ",
                    paste(unique(dat$Finished[!assigned]), collapse = ", "), ".")),
  check.names = FALSE))
```

### 3.3 Columns in the data not described in the questionnaire

```{r extra}
meta <- c("StartDate", "EndDate", "Status", "Progress", "Duration (in seconds)", "Finished",
          "RecordedDate", "ResponseId", "DistributionChannel", "UserLanguage",
          "Q_DuplicateRespondent", "Last Seen Flow Element ID", "Last Seen Question IDs", "id")
extra  <- setdiff(names(dat), c(expected, meta, "group"))
second <- extra[grepl("^(baseline|task[0-9])_", extra)]
socio  <- setdiff(extra, c(second, "VU treatment"))
early  <- socio[match(socio, names(dat)) < match("Q0b", names(dat))]
early_txt <- paste0("`", early, "`", collapse = ", ")
early_answered <- sum(rowSums(!is.na(dat[!assigned, early, drop = FALSE])) > 0)

kable(data.frame(
  Group = c("Socio-demographics", "Second study (shopping tasks)", "Unclear"),
  Columns = c(paste0("`", socio, "`", collapse = ", "),
              paste0("`baseline_*` (", sum(grepl("^baseline_", second)), "), ",
                     paste0("`task", 1:3, "_*` (", sapply(1:3, function(k) sum(grepl(paste0("^task", k, "_"), second))), ")",
                            collapse = ", ")),
              "`VU treatment`"),
  n = c(length(socio), length(second), 1)))
```

**`r length(early)` socio-demographic items come before the diet screening.** These are `r early_txt`. They sit before `Q0b` in the column order, and `r early_answered` of the `r n_screen` screened-out respondents answered them. This matches student reports that the food-spending questions "repeated twice, at the start and then again later". Each item has only one column, so a second showing is either not recorded or overwrites the first answer. This needs checking in the survey flow.

## 4. Range check (completers, n = `r n_comp`)

The export contains **numeric codes, not labels**, and these are recoded to the questionnaire values. The mapping was verified against a Qualtrics label export of the same survey for 9 respondents present in both files. Codes that did not occur among those 9 are marked as *inferred* and should be confirmed in Qualtrics (*Recode values*).

| Items | Raw code to questionnaire value |
|---|---|
| Emotions | 1-5 to 0-4 (1 Not at all, 2 Slightly, 3 Moderately, 5 Very much verified; 4 Quite a bit inferred) |
| Attention check | 1-4 unchanged (2 animal suffering, 3 sleep verified; 1 pollution/hygiene, 4 exercise inferred) |
| Moralization, Q07a, association check | 1-7 unchanged |
| Q07b | 1 to 1, 2 to 2, **8 to 3, 9 to 4 (inferred), 10 to 5, 11 to 6, 3 to 7** |
| Q07c | 1 to 1, 2 to 2 (inferred), **8 to 3 (inferred), 9 to 4, 10 to 5, 3 to 6, 4 to 7** |
| Choice Q10-Q20 | 1 to 0 (animal-based), 2 to 1 (plant-based), verified |
| Q22, Q23 (MFQ) | 1-6 to 0-5 |

```{r range-table}
kable(res, row.names = FALSE)
```

**Result:** `r n_invalid` invalid codes, `r n_oor` out-of-range values and `r n_miss` missing values among completers.

### 4.1 Logical checks

```{r logical}
correct    <- c(control = 3, harm = 2, purity = 1)
cc         <- num[completed, , drop = FALSE]
cc$att_ok  <- cc$`attention check` == correct[as.character(cc$group)]
att_tab    <- table(cc$group, factor(cc$`attention check`, levels = 1:4))
att_txt    <- sapply(levels(cc$group), function(g)
  sprintf("%s %d of %d", g, sum(cc$att_ok[cc$group == g], na.rm = TRUE), sum(cc$group == g)))

vu_tab    <- table(dat$Group[completed], dat$`VU treatment`[completed], useNA = "ifany")
diet_tab  <- table(dat$Q0b[completed])
dur       <- as.numeric(dat$`Duration (in seconds)`[completed])
dup       <- sum(dat$Q_DuplicateRespondent[completed] %in% "true")
sl        <- function(vs) sum(apply(cc[, vs, drop = FALSE], 1, function(r) length(unique(r[!is.na(r)])) == 1))
choice_share <- colMeans(cc[, names(products), drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

att_group_text <- if (length(att_tab) == 0L) "No complete cases" else paste0(rownames(att_tab), " ", apply(att_tab, 1, paste, collapse = "/"), collapse = "; ")
vu_text <- if (length(vu_tab) == 0L) "No complete cases" else {
  paste0("Columns ", paste(colnames(vu_tab), collapse = " / "), ": ",
         paste(rownames(vu_tab), apply(vu_tab, 1, paste, collapse = " / "), collapse = "; "))
}
diet_text <- if (length(diet_tab) == 0L) "No complete cases" else paste(names(diet_tab), diet_tab, sep = ": ", collapse = "; ")
choice_text <- if (length(choice_share) == 0L || all(is.na(choice_share))) {
  "No valid plant-choice data in the current export."
} else {
  sprintf("%.2f (%s) to %.2f (%s).", min(choice_share, na.rm = TRUE),
          names(which.min(choice_share)), max(choice_share, na.rm = TRUE), names(which.max(choice_share)))
}

logical_rows <- data.frame(
  Check = c("Attention check passed", "Attention check answers by group (codes 1/2/3/4)",
            "`VU treatment` codes by `Group`", "Diet of completers (`Q0b` code: n)",
            "Duplicate flag", "Duration", "Straight-lining", "Plant-based choice share per item"),
  Result = c(
    sprintf("**%d of %d (%.0f%%).** %s.", sum(cc$att_ok, na.rm = TRUE), n_comp,
            if (n_comp == 0) 0 else 100 * mean(cc$att_ok, na.rm = TRUE),
            paste(att_txt, collapse = "; ")),
    att_group_text,
    vu_text,
    diet_text,
    sprintf("%d of %d completers have `Q_DuplicateRespondent` = true.", dup, n_comp),
    if (length(dur) == 0L) "No complete cases" else sprintf("Median %.0f s (about %.0f min), range %.0f-%.0f s. **%d completers took under 300 s.**",
            median(dur, na.rm = TRUE), median(dur, na.rm = TRUE) / 60,
            min(dur, na.rm = TRUE), max(dur, na.rm = TRUE), sum(dur < 300, na.rm = TRUE)),
    if (n_comp == 0) "No complete cases" else sprintf("Same answer on all items: emotions %d, perceived harm %d, MFQ (14 items) %d.",
            sl(paste0("emotions_", 1:6)), sl(it("Perceived harm")),
            sl(c(paste0("Q22_", 1:7), paste0("Q23_", 1:7)))),
    choice_text
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

kable(logical_rows, row.names = FALSE)
```

`Q0b` codes: 0 = vegan, 1 = neither vegetarian nor vegan, 2 = vegetarian, 3 = vegetarian with a non-vegetarian household, 4 = label unknown. Many respondents straight-lining on the emotion items is plausible for the control text, where "not at all" is the natural answer.

### 4.2 Composite scores (descriptive only)

The composites are computed as preregistered. The pilot sample consists of students and includes vegetarians, and n is small, so the table only shows that the scores can be computed and behave sensibly. It is not a test of the hypotheses.

```{r composites}
cc$moralization      <- rowMeans(cc[, it("Moralization")])
cc$perceived_harm    <- rowMeans(cc[, it("Perceived harm")])
cc$disgust           <- rowMeans(cc[, it("Disgust")])
cc$compassion        <- rowMeans(cc[, it("Compassion")])
cc$harm_assoc        <- rowMeans(cc[, it("Harm association")])
cc$purity_assoc      <- rowMeans(cc[, it("Purity association")])
cc$plant_choice_prop <- rowMeans(cc[, names(products)])
cc$mft_care          <- rowMeans(cc[, it("MFQ care")])
cc$mft_purity        <- rowMeans(cc[, it("MFQ purity")])

comp <- c(moralization = "1-7", perceived_harm = "1-7", disgust = "0-4", compassion = "0-4",
          harm_assoc = "1-7", purity_assoc = "1-7", plant_choice_prop = "0-1",
          mft_care = "0-5", mft_purity = "0-5")
ms <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
ct <- data.frame(
  Score = paste0("`", names(comp), "`"),
  Range = comp,
  Control = sapply(names(comp), function(v) ms(cc[[v]][cc$group == "control"])),
  Harm = sapply(names(comp), function(v) ms(cc[[v]][cc$group == "harm"])),
  Purity = sapply(names(comp), function(v) ms(cc[[v]][cc$group == "purity"])),
  check.names = FALSE
)
names(ct)[3:5] <- sprintf("%s (n = %d)", c("Control", "Harm", "Purity"), c(grp_n[["control"]], grp_n[["harm"]], grp_n[["purity"]]))
kable(ct, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Mean (SD) by group")
```

## 5. Problems to fix before fieldwork

```{r socio-checks}
multi   <- sapply(c("Q30.meat_culture_fit", "Q31.difficult_nomeat"),
                  function(v) sum(grepl(",", dat[[v]][completed])))
fam1    <- sort(unique(as.numeric(dat$Q35.family_1[!is.na(dat$Q35.family_1)])))
q39     <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat$Q39.food_expenditure))
q39_big <- q39[!is.na(q39) & q39 > 10000]
n_nonmeat <- sum(dat$Q0b[completed] != "1")
```

1. **Q07b and Q07c have non-sequential recode values.** Q07b is coded `r q07b_codes` and Q07c `r q07c_codes`, so "Strongly agree" is stored as 3. Analysing the raw codes would be badly wrong. In Qualtrics, set *Recode values* for these two matrices to 1-7. While there, align the emotions to 0-4 and the MFQ to 0-5, so the export matches the questionnaire and the preregistration. Until then, use the mapping in Section 4 and confirm the inferred codes.
2. **There is no country variable.** Every preregistered model needs Country.
3. **The diet screening removes only vegans.** `r n_nonmeat` of `r n_comp` completers do not report a diet that includes meat (`Q0b` codes 2, 3 and 4). The preregistration screens out vegetarians, vegans and pescatarians. Code 4 has no known label, so add the answer options to the questionnaire. Student feedback adds that vegans who were screened out without explanation restarted with a false diet answer. The screen-out page needs a short message.
4. **`r length(early)` socio-demographic items are shown before the screening and possibly twice** (Section 3.3). Check the survey flow.
5. **`Finished` alone cannot identify completers.** Use a non-missing `Group` together with Finished = 1, or add an end-of-survey embedded-data flag.
6. **The `id` column is empty.**
7. **The end redirect returns a 401 error.** This comes from the student feedback: students saw `{"success":false,"code":401,...}` after submitting. Fix it together with the panel provider's end link.
8. **Some socio-demographic items need validation, although they are outside the main study.**
    - `Q30` and `Q31` allow multiple answers to single-choice questions (`r multi[1]` and `r multi[2]` completers respectively).
    - `Q35.family_1` uses the codes `r paste(fam1, collapse = ", ")`.
    - `Q39` food expenditure has no bounds: `r length(q39_big)` values are above 10,000, with a maximum of `r format(max(c(q39_big, NA), na.rm = TRUE), scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)`. Add a numeric range validation and state the currency.

## 6. Points that need clarification

9. **What is `VU treatment` (0/1/2)?** It is filled only for the VU group, which fits a second-study condition randomized among control participants. Please confirm.
10. **What do `Q0b` code 4 and `Q32.gender` code 2 mean?** Neither label is available in the export.
11. **Randomization orders are not exported.** Enable "Export viewing order data for randomized surveys" in Qualtrics.
12. **The Q04 wording differs.** Qualtrics reads "When thinking about the text...", while the questionnaire and preregistration read "While reading the text...".
13. **The MFQ scoring key is an assumption.** The report uses Q22_1-3 and Q23_1-3 for care, Q22_4-6 and Q23_4-6 for purity, and Q22_7 and Q23_7 as fillers.
14. **How should speeders, duplicates and attention-check failures be handled?** The preregistration excludes only non-completers and uses attention-check failures in a sensitivity analysis. Decide whether to preregister handling for completion times under 300 s and for the `Q_DuplicateRespondent` flag.

```{r save}
write.csv(res,  file.path(out_dir, "pilot_check_summary.csv"),     row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(long, file.path(out_dir, "pilot_check_values_long.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(cc,     file.path(out_dir, "pilot_recoded_main_study.rds"))
```

## 7. Outputs

Rendering this file also writes these files to the working directory:

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `pilot_check_summary.csv` | The range-check table (Section 4) |
| `pilot_check_values_long.csv` | Frequency of every raw code per item |
| `pilot_recoded_main_study.rds` | Recoded items and preregistered composites for the completers |
